-1-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:5667  WP No. 201975 of 2023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA,
 KALABURAGI BENCH  DATED THIS THE 20TH DAY OF JULY, 2023  BEFORE  THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURAJ GOVINDARAJ  WRIT PETITION NO. 201975 OF 2023 (LA-RES)
 BETWEEN:
 SHANTAMMA  WIFE OF LATE SUBHASH  AGE 62 YEARS  OCCUPATION AGRICULTURE  RESIDENT OF NILWAD TALUK DISTRICT BIDAR  ...PETITIONER  (BY SRI. SANDEEP VIJAYKUMAR,ADVOCATE)
 AND:
 THE STATE OF KARNATAKA  REPRESENTED BY SPECIAL LAND ACQUISITION OFFICER,
 KARANJA PROJECT, BIDAR - 585401.
Digitally signed by B NAGAVENI Location: HIGH COURT OF ...RESPONDENT KARNATAKA  (BY SMT. MAYA T.R., HCGP)
 THIS WRIT PETITION FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227  OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO ISSUE WRIT OF  MANDAMUS DIRECTING THE RESPONDENT TO CONSIDER THE  REPRESENTATION DATED 19.10.2022 AS PER ANNEXURE- B IN Shantamma vs The State Of Karnataka on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157957226/
1  RESPECT OF PROPERTY OF THE PETITIONER, IN THE INTEREST OF  JUSTICE AND EQUITY AND ETC.
 *****
 THIS WRIT PETITION, COMING ON FOR HEARING, THIS DAY,
 THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:5667  WP No. 201975 of 2023  ORDER 1.
Learned High Court Government Pleader accepts notice for the respondent.

2. The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs;
a. Issue writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the representation dated 19.10.2022 as per Annexure-B in respect of property of the petitioner, in the interest of justice and equity. b.
Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble court deems fit in circumstances of the case, in ends of justice and equity.
3.

The grievance of the petitioner is that though enhanced compensation has been paid as regards similarly situated land acquired under the very same notification, the said enhanced compensation has not been made available to the petitioner.

4. Whenever any land is acquired and compensation is enhanced, it is required that all the land losers also be made available the same compensation as held by this Court in MSA.No.200186/2019 disposed of on 11.02.2021.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i.

ii. A mandamus is issued directing the respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 19.10.2022 at Annexure-B by treating the same as an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.

Sd/-
